subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` replace its current isolated embedded fallback with fail-closed reattach-first recovery by default for ambiguous Gateway disconnects, or retain automatic fallback as the compatibility default?
rationale: This changes a public CLI recovery contract, including whether users receive a fallback result automatically, and the linked issue identifies material streaming, delivery, and operator tradeoffs that code review cannot choose safely.

options.title: Approve reattach-first default
options.body: Adopt fail-closed recovery as the supported default, document the changed behavior, and require live proof for successful recovery and every terminal fallback outcome.

options.title: Preserve automatic fallback
options.body: Keep the current fresh-session fallback as the default and expose reattach-first only behind an explicit opt-in until a later product decision.

recommendation.title: Preserve automatic fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the current fresh-session fallback as the default and expose reattach-first only behind an explicit opt-in until a later product decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the current main fallback containment and is the strongest history-backed routing candidate for its replacement contract.
